items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I had heard, I didn't hear Joe Oliver play until he come to work for Pete Lallers... So I used to go, I was too young to go into the halls, I'd stand outside and listen to Joe.

ctx.x: Did he really have great big feet I think Bunk told me about it. Yeah he had big feet. Foots was a bouncer and had feet almost big as the funky but all.

Yeah Foots was a great band. Foots was a great band. So Foots was with the Eagle Band and Frankie Dusen and Pache was a little boy that was playing clarinet in this band. So all the guys, when I walked in the place, Foots bought me and they thought I was Frankie Dusen's part because I looked like Frankie at that time. Frankie was slant and they were resembled each other. So they had wore uniforms, I'm going to get them, all them brown uniforms at that time. And I put on Bunk's Eagle cap and picked up his counter…
